title: 🏛️ SEBI Demat Reforms — 1-Year Window for Pre-2019 Shares & 30-Day Transfer Timelines
summary: SEBI abolished Letter of Confirmation (LOC) requirement, enabling RTAs to directly credit demat shares and reducing transfer timelines from 150 days to 30 days from 2 April 2026.

blocks.content: **Overview**: SEBI abolished Letter of Confirmation (LOC) requirement, enabling RTAs to directly credit demat shares and reducing transfer timelines from 150 days to 30 days from 2 April 2026.

items: **SEBI Cuts Demat Transfer Period from 150 Days to 30 Days via Direct RTA Credit** (Page 36): SEBI abolished Letter of Confirmation (LOC) requirement, enabling RTAs to directly credit demat shares and reducing transfer timelines from 150 days to 30 days from 2 April 2026.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Securities Dematerialisation & Investor Rights. 1-year window (Feb 2026-Feb 2027) for legacy shares with 1-yr lock-in, and elimination of LOC reducing transfer time to 30 days.
